Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

In GLM context-parallel prefill, the existing MoE input path gathers BF16 hidden states before routing and activation quantization. This transfers full-precision activations and repeats routing and quantization across CP ranks.

This change moves routing and activation quantization before the CP AllGather, allowing ranks to communicate FP8 activations together with the scales and routing metadata. Fused packing and unpacking reduce the overhead of preparing the communication payload.

## Modifications

- Add an opt-in `SGLANG_CP_MOE_FP8_TRANSPORT=1` environment variable. The optimization is disabled by default.
- Compute routing from the original local BF16 hidden states, then perform local block-wise FP8 activation quantization.
- Fuse FP8 activations, FP32 scales, routing weights, and expert IDs into a single aligned byte payload.
- Use one CP AllGather for the packed payload and fuse unpacking into the downstream input tensors.
- Extend layer-boundary declarations to support compute-owned CP input gathering while preserving the existing output-reduction contract.
- Allow the eligible DeepGEMM path to consume prequantized inputs without quantizing them again.
- Retain the existing BF16 path for unsupported configurations.
- Add correctness tests and standalone packing/unpacking benchmarks.

The optimized path currently targets eligible GLM interleaved CP configurations with CP/TP group sharing, CP size equal to TP size, and EP=1. It does not enable general EP>1 support.

## Accuracy Tests

- Kernel correctness and CUDA Graph replay tests: **28 passed**.
- Layer-boundary regression tests: **14 passed**.
- Four-GPU preparation-chain validation passed for global token counts of **4,096, 8,192, 17,408, 32,768, and 65,536**:
  - FP8 activation bytes matched exactly.
  - FP32 quantization scales matched exactly.
  - Expert IDs and their ordering matched exactly.
  - Maximum routing-weight absolute difference: **2.68e-7**.
- Verified that the DeepGEMM prequantized-input dispatch consumes the supplied FP8 tensors rather than the BF16 placeholder.
- Targeted Ruff checks and `git diff --check` passed.

The four-GPU tests used actual GLM router weights with synthetic BF16 inputs. Full-model GSM8K and end-to-end serving regression have not yet been run for this change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured the complete MoE input-preparation chain on **4× NVIDIA H200 GPUs**, using SGLang's PyNcclCommunicator.

Compared paths:

```text
Baseline:
BF16 AllGather → global routing → global FP8 quantization

Optimized:
local routing → local FP8 quantization → fused packing
→ FP8 payload AllGather → fused unpacking → scale-layout conversion
```

Both paths produce equivalent downstream input tensors. The optimized timings include the scale-layout conversion required by the tested DeepGEMM compact-input path.

Test configuration:

- Hidden size: 4,096
- CP size: 4
- FP8 quantization group size: 128
- Top-k metadata: 8 routed experts + 1 shared expert
- Actual GLM layer-45 router weights
- CUDA Graph timing with rotating input buffers exceeding L2 capacity
- Five alternating trials, with the slowest-rank latency used for each sample

| Global tokens | Local tokens/rank | Baseline (ms) | Optimized (ms) | Speedup | Latency reduction |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4,096 | 1,024 | 0.1513 | 0.1060 | 1.43× | 29.9% |
| 8,192 | 2,048 | 0.2650 | 0.1711 | 1.55× | 35.5% |
| 17,408 | 4,352 | 0.5419 | 0.3241 | 1.67× | 40.2% |
| 32,768 | 8,192 | 0.9634 | 0.5675 | 1.70× | 41.1% |
| 65,536 | 16,384 | 1.8628 | 1.0937 | 1.70× | 41.3% |

The per-token communication payload decreases from **8,192 bytes to 4,304 bytes**, including scales, routing metadata, and alignment padding: a **47.5% reduction**.

These results measure the input-preparation chain only. They exclude expert dispatch, MoE GEMMs, output reduction, and full-model execution, and should not be interpreted as end-to-end model speedups.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+"""Bit-preserving pack/unpack of FP8 activations, FP32 scales and routing.
+
+This is a local format conversion, with no process-group/runtime dependency.
+The byte packet stores q, scales, weights and int32 IDs per row, padded to 16B.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack(
+    Q,
+    S,
+    W,
+    I,
+    P,
+    M,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    SS0,
+    SS1,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    q = tl.load(Q + row * H + col, col < H, 0).to(tl.uint32)
+    sg = (col - H) // 4
+    s = tl.load(S + row * SS0 + sg * SS1, (col >= H) & (col < H + H // 128 * 4), 0).to(
+        tl.uint32, bitcast=True
+    )
+    wp = col - H - H // 128 * 4
+    w = tl.load(W + row * K + wp // 4, (wp >= 0) & (wp < K * 4), 0).to(
+        tl.uint32, bitcast=True
+    )
+    ip = wp - K * 4
+    ids = tl.load(I + row * K + ip // 4, (ip >= 0) & (ip < K * 4), 0).to(tl.uint32)
+    value = tl.where(
+        col < H,
+        q,
+        tl.where(
+            col < H + H // 128 * 4,
+            (s >> ((col % 4) * 8)) & 255,
+            tl.where(
+                wp < K * 4,
+                (w >> ((wp % 4) * 8)) & 255,
+                tl.where(ip < K * 4, (ids >> ((ip % 4) * 8)) & 255, 0),
+            ),
+        ),
+    )
+    tl.store(P + row * WIDTH + col, value.to(tl.uint8), col < WIDTH)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _unpack(
+    P,
+    Q,
+    S,
+    W,
+    I,
+    M,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    SM,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    C: tl.constexpr,
+    GS: tl.constexpr,
+    KS: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    rows = tl.program_id(0) * R + tl.arange(0, R)
+    cols = tl.program_id(1) * C + tl.arange(0, C)
+    q = tl.load(
+        P + rows[:, None] * WIDTH + cols[None, :],
+        (rows[:, None] < M) & (cols[None, :] < H),
+        0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        Q + rows[:, None] * H + cols[None, :],
+        q,
+        (rows[:, None] < M) & (cols[None, :] < H),
+    )
+    if tl.program_id(1) == 0:
+        gs = tl.arange(0, GS)
+        soff = rows[:, None] * WIDTH + H + gs[None, :] * 4
+        smask = (rows[:, None] < M) & (gs[None, :] < H // 128)
+        bits = tl.load(P + soff, smask, 0).to(tl.uint32)
+        bits |= tl.load(P + soff + 1, smask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 8
+        bits |= tl.load(P + soff + 2, smask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 16
+        bits |= tl.load(P + soff + 3, smask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 24
+        tl.store(
+            S + rows[:, None] + gs[None, :] * SM,
+            bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True),
+            smask,
+        )
+        ks = tl.arange(0, KS)
+        mask = (rows[:, None] < M) & (ks[None, :] < K)
+        off = rows[:, None] * WIDTH + H + H // 128 * 4 + ks[None, :] * 4
+        wb = tl.load(P + off, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32)
+        wb |= tl.load(P + off + 1, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 8
+        wb |= tl.load(P + off + 2, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 16
+        wb |= tl.load(P + off + 3, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 24
+        off += K * 4
+        ib = tl.load(P + off, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32)
+        ib |= tl.load(P + off + 1, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 8
+        ib |= tl.load(P + off + 2, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 16
+        ib |= tl.load(P + off + 3, mask, 0).to(tl.uint32) << 24
+        tl.store(
+            W + rows[:, None] * K + ks[None, :], wb.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True), mask
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            I + rows[:, None] * K + ks[None, :], ib.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True), mask
+        )
+
+
+def pack_moe_fp8(q, scale, weights, ids):
+    """Pack contiguous FP8/routing rows and arbitrarily strided FP32 scales."""
+    if (
+        q.ndim != 2
+        or not q.is_cuda
+        or q.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or not q.is_contiguous()
+        or q.shape[1] <= 0
+        or q.shape[1] % 128
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Expected contiguous CUDA FP8 [rows, hidden] with group 128")
+    m, hidden = q.shape
+    if weights.ndim != 2 or weights.shape[0] != m or weights.shape[1] <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Expected routing weights [rows, topk] with positive topk")
+    if (
+        scale.shape != (m, hidden // 128)
+        or scale.dtype != torch.float32
+        or weights.dtype != torch.float32
+        or ids.dtype != torch.int32
+        or ids.shape != weights.shape
+        or not weights.is_contiguous()
+        or not ids.is_contiguous()
+        or any(t.device != q.device for t in (scale, weights, ids))
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid FP32 scale/weight or int32 routing ID layout")
+    topk = weights.shape[1]
+    width = triton.cdiv(hidden + hidden // 128 * 4 + topk * 8, 16) * 16
+    payload = torch.empty((m, width), device=q.device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    if m:
+        _pack[(m,)](
+            q.view(torch.uint8),
+            scale,
+            weights,
+            ids,
+            payload,
+            m,
+            hidden,
+            topk,
+            *scale.stride(),
+            width,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+            num_warps=8,
+        )
+    return payload
+
+
+def unpack_moe_fp8(payload, hidden, topk):
+    """Restore exact values and TMA-aligned column-major FP32 scales."""
+    if (
+        payload.ndim != 2
+        or not payload.is_cuda
+        or payload.dtype != torch.uint8
+        or not payload.is_contiguous()
+        or hidden <= 0
+        or hidden % 128
+        or topk <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid CUDA byte payload, hidden or topk")
+    m, width = payload.shape
+    if width != triton.cdiv(hidden + hidden // 128 * 4 + topk * 8, 16) * 16:
+        raise ValueError("Payload width does not match hidden/topk")
+    q = torch.empty((m, hidden), device=payload.device, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = torch.empty(
+        (hidden // 128, triton.cdiv(m, 4) * 4),
+        device=payload.device,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    ).t()[:m]
+    weights = torch.empty((m, topk), device=payload.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    ids = torch.empty_like(weights, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if m:
+        _unpack[(triton.cdiv(m, 4), triton.cdiv(hidden, 1024))](
+            payload,
+            q.view(torch.uint8),
+            scale,
+            weights,
+            ids,
+            m,
+            hidden,
+            topk,
+            width,
+            scale.stride(1),
+            4,
+            1024,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(hidden // 128),
+            triton.next_power_of_2(topk),
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+    return q, scale, weights, ids

@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+"""Opt-in FP8 input all-gather for GLM's interleaved CP / TP MoE.
+
+Route the original BF16 shard locally and gather its exact router results with
+the FP8 values/scales. Expert weights, output reduction and residual ownership
+remain with the existing model and layer boundary. Unsupported layers gather
+BF16 through the original model path instead. No EP/A2A or MTP support is added.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+_ENABLED = os.environ.get("SGLANG_CP_MOE_FP8_TRANSPORT", "0") == "1"
+_LAYERS = {}
+_LOGGED = False
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+def cp_moe_fp8_transport_enabled():
+    if not _ENABLED:
+        return False
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import get_moe_a2a_backend, get_moe_runner_backend
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    p = get_parallel()
+    return (
+        p.enable_prefill_cp
+        and p.enable_cp_tp_group_sharing
+        and p.cp_strategy == "interleave"
+        and p.attn_cp_size == p.tp_size
+        and p.attn_cp_size > 1
+        and p.attn_dp_size == 1
+        and p.moe_dp_size == 1
+        and p.moe_ep_size == 1
+        and p.pp_size == 1
+        and get_moe_a2a_backend().value == "none"
+        and (
+            get_moe_runner_backend().is_triton()
+            or get_moe_runner_backend().is_deep_gemm()
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def register_cp_moe_fp8_layer(layer):
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+
+    layer._cp_fp8_transport_eligible = False
+    if (
+        not cp_moe_fp8_transport_enabled()
+        or layer.is_nextn
+        or layer.reduce_results
+        or layer.moe_ep_size != 1
+        or getattr(layer, "is_hash", False)
+        or layer.gate.e_score_correction_bias_vl is not None
+        or get_exec().moe.enable_eplb
+    ):
+        return
+    # The quantization runner is finalized only after weight loading.
+    layer._cp_fp8_transport_eligible = None
+    _LAYERS[layer.layer_id] = layer
+
+
+def cp_moe_fp8_layer_eligible(layer):
+    if layer._cp_fp8_transport_eligible is None:

+"""Unfused Torch wire-format reference for tests and microbenchmarks only."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def pack_reference(q, scale, weights, ids):
+    rows, hidden = q.shape
+
+    def row_bytes(tensor):
+        flat = tensor.reshape(-1).contiguous()
+        if flat.stride(-1) != 1:
+            flat = torch.empty(tensor.numel(), device=tensor.device, dtype=tensor.dtype)
+            flat.copy_(tensor.reshape(-1))
+        return flat.view(torch.uint8).reshape(
+            rows, tensor.shape[1] * tensor.element_size()
+        )
+
+    pieces = [q.view(torch.uint8), row_bytes(scale), row_bytes(weights), row_bytes(ids)]
+    padding = (-(hidden + scale.shape[1] * 4 + weights.shape[1] * 8)) % 16
+    if padding:
+        pieces.append(q.new_zeros((rows, padding), dtype=torch.uint8))
+    return torch.cat(pieces, dim=1)
+
+
+def unpack_reference(payload, hidden, topk):
+    scale_end = hidden + hidden // 128 * 4
+    weights_end = scale_end + topk * 4
+    q = payload[:, :hidden].contiguous().view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = payload[:, hidden:scale_end].contiguous().view(torch.float32)
+    scale = scale.t().contiguous().t()
+    weights = payload[:, scale_end:weights_end].contiguous().view(torch.float32)
+    ids = (
+        payload[:, weights_end : weights_end + topk * 4].contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+    )
+    return q, scale, weights, ids

+"""Cold-L2 packet conversion latency, excluding routing/quantization/NCCL."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.benchmark import marker
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.moe_fp8_packet import (
+    pack_moe_fp8,
+    unpack_moe_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.moe_fp8_packet import pack_reference, unpack_reference
+
+register_cuda_ci(
+    est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-benchmark", runner_config="1-gpu-large"
+)
+
+
+def measure(rows, operation, provider):
+    hidden, topk = 4096, 9
+    q = torch.randn((rows, hidden), device="cuda").to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = torch.rand((hidden // 128, rows), device="cuda").t()
+    weights = torch.rand((rows, topk), device="cuda")
+    ids = torch.randint(-1, 289, (rows, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    if operation == "pack":
+        fn = pack_moe_fp8 if provider == "fused" else pack_reference
+        args = q, scale, weights, ids
+    else:
+        packet = pack_reference(q, scale, weights, ids)
+        unpack = unpack_moe_fp8 if provider == "fused" else unpack_reference
+
+        def fn(packet):
+            return unpack(packet, hidden, topk)
+
+        args = (packet,)
+
+    # Keep captured outputs live: allocator reuse must not make writes L2-hot.
+    # marker rotates all read arguments beyond five times the device's L2.
+    outputs = []
+
+    def retained(*inputs):
+        result = fn(*inputs)
+        outputs.append(result)
+        return result
+
+    return marker.do_bench(
+        retained,
+        input_args=args,
+        graph_clone_args="all",
+        warmup_iters=3,
+        replay_iters=500,
+        disable_log_bandwidth=True,
+    )
+
+
+@marker.parametrize("rows", [4096, 8192, 16384, 32768], [8192])
+@marker.parametrize("operation", ["pack", "unpack"])
+@marker.benchmark("provider", ["reference", "fused"])
+def benchmark(rows, operation, provider):
+    return measure(rows, operation, provider)
+
+

+"""Guard the bit-exact wire contract, strided scales, padding and graph replay."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.moe_fp8_packet import (
+    pack_moe_fp8,
+    unpack_moe_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.moe_fp8_packet import pack_reference, unpack_reference
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+
+def _inputs(rows, hidden, topk, column_major):
+    q = torch.randint(0, 256, (rows, hidden), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8).view(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    # Arbitrary float bits include signed zeros, infinities and NaNs. The packet
+    # must preserve bits, not approximate or canonicalize floating values.
+    scale = torch.randint(
+        -(2**31), 2**31 - 1, (rows, hidden // 128), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+    ).view(torch.float32)
+    if column_major:
+        scale = scale.t().contiguous().t()
+    weights = torch.randn((rows, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    ids = torch.randint(-1, 289, (rows, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    return q, scale, weights, ids
+
+
+def _bytes(tensor):
+    # Explicit dense storage also fixes one-element TMA strides.
+    dense = torch.empty(tensor.numel(), device=tensor.device, dtype=tensor.dtype)
+    dense.copy_(tensor.reshape(-1))
+    return dense.view(torch.uint8).reshape(tensor.shape[0], -1)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 3, 129, 1024])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden,topk", [(128, 1), (512, 9), (4096, 9)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("column_major", [False, True])
+def test_packet_exact_wire_and_roundtrip(rows, hidden, topk, column_major):
+    inputs = _inputs(rows, hidden, topk, column_major)
+    packet = pack_moe_fp8(*inputs)
+    assert torch.equal(packet, pack_reference(*inputs))
+    restored = unpack_moe_fp8(packet, hidden, topk)
+    reference_restored = unpack_reference(packet, hidden, topk)
+    for actual, reference, expected in zip(restored, reference_restored, inputs):
+        assert torch.equal(_bytes(actual), _bytes(expected))
+        assert torch.equal(_bytes(actual), _bytes(reference))
+    assert restored[1].stride(0) == 1
+    assert restored[1].stride(1) % 4 == 0
+
+
+def test_packet_empty():
+    inputs = _inputs(0, 512, 9, True)
+    packet = pack_moe_fp8(*inputs)
+    restored = unpack_moe_fp8(packet, 512, 9)
+    assert packet.shape == (0, 608)
+    for actual, expected in zip(restored, inputs):
+        assert actual.shape == expected.shape
+        assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype
+
+
+def test_rank_major_gather_preserves_token_and_router_order():
+    shards = [_inputs(129, 512, 9, True) for _ in range(4)]
+    gathered = torch.cat([pack_moe_fp8(*shard) for shard in shards])
+    actual = unpack_moe_fp8(gathered, 512, 9)
+    for index, tensor in enumerate(actual):
+        expected = torch.cat([shard[index] for shard in shards])
+        assert torch.equal(_bytes(tensor), _bytes(expected))
+
+
+def test_packet_graph_replay_reads_updated_inputs():
+    inputs = _inputs(129, 512, 9, True)
+    unpack_moe_fp8(pack_moe_fp8(*inputs), 512, 9)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        packet = pack_moe_fp8(*inputs)
+        restored = unpack_moe_fp8(packet, 512, 9)
+    for old, new in zip(inputs, _inputs(129, 512, 9, True)):
+        old.copy_(new)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    assert torch.equal(packet, pack_reference(*inputs))
+    for actual, expected in zip(restored, inputs):
+        assert torch.equal(_bytes(actual), _bytes(expected))
+
+
+def test_packet_rejects_invalid_width_and_scale():
+    inputs = _inputs(3, 512, 9, True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        pack_moe_fp8(inputs[0], inputs[1][:, :1], inputs[2], inputs[3])
+    packet = pack_moe_fp8(*inputs)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        unpack_moe_fp8(packet, 1024, 9)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))

+            baseline = declare_ffn(sparse=True, exit_rows=factories.ExitRows.ATTENTION)
+            deferred = replace(baseline, gathers_attn_cp_input=True)
+            for variant in (BatchVariant.ORDINARY, BatchVariant.CONTEXT_PARALLEL):
+                normal = factories._resolve_stage(baseline, variant, None)
+                actual = factories._resolve_stage(deferred, variant, None)
+                self.assertEqual(actual.contract.output, normal.contract.output)
+                self.assertEqual(actual.during, normal.during)
+                self.assertEqual(actual.returned, normal.returned)
+                if variant is BatchVariant.CONTEXT_PARALLEL:
+                    self.assertIn(

+                    self.assertIsNotNone(actual.contract.output.group)
+                else:
+                    self.assertEqual(actual.contract, normal.contract)
+            # A declaration retains the capability when recorded as facts.
+            self.assertTrue(facts_of(deferred).gathers_attn_cp_input)
+            parallel.enable_cp_tp_group_sharing = False
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(NotImplementedError, "full-TP sparse FFN"):
